verdicts.decision_note: The client defines the Airbnb interface action of sending the supplied outreach template to hosts by copy and paste; administrative timing statements are not encoded.
This is the first concrete failure: Airbnb blocked the target template because it contained prohibited platform names.
The platform rejection creates a material unresolved template decision between removing prohibited names and revising the outreach copy.
The client repeats the copy-and-paste instruction but does not resolve whether the Airbnb-blocked platform names should be removed or the template revised, so RESUME is unsupported.
